defects.description: Detector flagged knees_apart (hipAbduct near 0 but description says knees apart). Confirmed: baseline has hipAbductL/R not set (both 0°), legs in neutral position, NOT apart.

Description says forearms resting on the thighs. Baseline arms have shoulderFwdL:+7 (slight backward) and shoulderFwdR:-5 (slight forward) — neither clearly forward; elbows 81/81 (deep bend). Wrists at z=+0.078/+0.166, thighs at z=0 to 0.384 — wrists only at thigh-start, not resting on thighs.

failing_tests.assertion: both legs should be abducted outward (hip abduction > 30°)
both wrists should be on thigh area (z between 0.15 and 0.35)
failing_tests.actual: L_wrist.z=+0.078, R_wrist.z=+0.166 (wrist at thigh-start, not on thigh)

regression_risk: low — symmetric multi-field change; verified geometry matches description; no flags
rationale: Real defect confirmed: hipAbduct not set, legs neutral instead of apart. Per actual renderer convention (empirically verified), NEGATIVE hipAbductL/R = leg spreads OUTWARD (renderer comment inverted: comment says + = outward but FK proves + = crosses inward). hipAbductL/R:-25 produces L_hip_abd=+69.6°, R_hip_abd=+69.6° (both legs abducted outward). Secondary defect: arms not resting on thighs. NEGATIVE shoulderFwdL/R moves wrists FORWARD when shoulder in default abduction (verified). shoulderFwdL/R:-25 produces sagittal flexion -0.6/+4.7 (near neutral, slightly forward); elbows deepened to 90° (right-angle, forearm horizontal). Wrists end at z=+0.249/+0.337 (mid-thigh area, between hip z=0 and knee z=0.384) — forearms resting on thighs. Verified no anomalies/plausibility flags.
